1.o: يتحمس (جيري) عندما تقرر امرأة التقى بها في لوس أنجلوس زيارة نيويورك والإقامة في شقته، لكنه يقع في حيرة من أمره ويحاول مع صديقه (جورج) تحليل تصرفاتها لمعرفة طبيعة مشاعرها تجاهه.

2.o: يلتقي (جيري) بامرأة جذابة في إحدى الحفلات ولكنه ينسى الحصول على رقم هاتفها، فيقترح عليه (جورج) خطة لانتظارها ومراقبة مبنى مكتبها للتظاهر بمقابلتها بالصدفة.

3.o: تتعرض شقة (جيري) للسرقة بعد أن ترك (كرايمر) الباب مفتوحاً، مما يدفع (جيري) للبحث عن شقة جديدة، وهو ما يدخله في منافسة وصراع غير متوقع مع (جورج) و(إيلين) حول من يحق له أخذ الشقة المتاحة.

4.o: يصل (جيري) إلى مرحلة يفقد فيها طاقة التحمل تجاه صديق قديم ومزعج من أيام الطفولة، ويحاول جاهدًا إيجاد طريقة لبقة لقطع علاقة الصداقة معه وإنهاء اللقاءات المستمرة بينهما.

5.o: يستثمر (جيري) و(جورج) أموالهما في سوق الأسهم بناءً على نصيحة داخلية من أحد المعارف، وبينما تنخفض قيمة الأسهم ويصاب (جيري) بالذعر، يقرر (جورج) التمسك بالاستثمار حتى النهاية.

1.o: يجد (جيري) نفسه في موقف محرج عندما يبدأ في تكوين صداقة مع الحبيب السابق لـ (إيلين) بعد انفصالهما مباشرة، في حين يحاول (جورج) جاهدًا إنهاء علاقة عاطفية يمر بها.

2.o: خلال عشاء عائلي، يدلي (جيري) بملاحظة عفوية ساخرة حول كراهيته للخيول الصغيرة (المُهر)، لكنه يقع في دوامة من الشعور بالذنب عندما تتوفى إحدى قريباته المسنات بعد العشاء بفترة وجيزة.

3.o: يشتري (جيري) سترة جلدية باهظة الثمن لتبهر الجميع، لكنه يقع في اختبار حقيقي وصعب عندما يضطر هو و(جورج) لتناول العشاء مع والد (إيلين) الصارم والمخيف.

4.o: يصاب (جورج) بالذعر بعد أن ترك سلسلة من الرسائل الهاتفية المحرجة واليائسة على جهاز الرد الآلي لامرأة يواعدها، ويستعين بـ (جيري) في خطة معقدة لاستبدال شريط الكاسيت قبل أن تسمعها.

5.o: يساعد (جيري) صديقته (إيلين) في الحصول على شقة متاحة في نفس المبنى الذي يعيش فيه، لكنه يبدأ سريعاً في الندم على هذه الفكرة بعد أن يدرك أن خصوصيته واستقلاليته قد تصبحان في خطر.

6.o: يرث (جيري) بعض المقتنيات القديمة ومن بينها تمثال صغير يثير إعجاب (جورج)، لكن التمثال يختفي فجأة بعد زيارة قام بها عامل تنظيف الشقة، مما يدفعهم للشك فيه ومحاولة استعادته.

7.o: يستقيل (جورج) من وظيفته بشكل متهور ثم يندم ويحاول العودة في اليوم التالي وكأن شيئاً لم يكن، وعندما يفشل، يقرر التخطيط للانتقام من رئيسه بمساعدة (إيلين)، بينما يشك (جيري) في أن صاحب المغسلة سرق أمواله.

8.o: يُنقل (جورج) إلى المستشفى معتقداً أنه يعاني من نوبة قلبية ليتضح أنها مشكلة في اللوزتين، ويقرر اللجوء إلى معالج بديل غريب الأطوار ينصح به (كرايمر) لتجنب تكاليف الجراحة المرتفعة.

9.o: يقرر (جيري) و(إيلين) وضع مجموعة صارمة من القواعد والشروط لإنشاء علاقة تجمع بين الصداقة والعاطفة دون الوقوع في المشاكل المعتادة، في محاولة لمعرفة ما إذا كان بإمكانهما الحفاظ على هذا الاتفاق.

10.o: تستغل (إيلين) غياب (جيري) لإقامة حفل استقبال مولود لصديقتها في شقته، بينما يدخل (جورج) لتصفية حساب قديم مع أحد الحاضرين، ويستغل (كرايمر) الموقف لتركيب قنوات فضائية غير قانونية.

11.o: يواجه (جيري) و(جورج) و(إيلين) اختباراً حقيقياً للصبر والتحمل أثناء انتظارهم الطويل والمليء بالمواقف المحرجة للحصول على طاولة في مطعم صيني مزدحم قبل بدء عرض فيلمهم السينمائي.

12.o: يتسبب (جورج) بطريق الخطأ في طرد مساعد نادل من عمله في أحد المطاعم، ويشعر بالذنب الشديد فيقرر هو و(كرايمر) زيارة الرجل في شقته لإصلاح الخطأ، مما يؤدي إلى سلسلة من العواقب غير المتوقعة.

1.o: يواجه (جورج) عائلة (سوزان) الراحلة ويُجبر على التواجد في مجلس إدارة مؤسسة خيرية أُنشئت باسمها، بينما تحاول (إيلين) التكيف مع مسؤوليات منصبها الإداري الجديد في الشركة.

2.o: يقع (جيري) في حب امرأة، لكنه يتفاجأ بأن (كرايمر) يراها أيضاً توأم روحه ويبدأ في منافسته عليها، في حين يشك (جورج) في أن أعضاء المؤسسة الخيرية يتجسسون على تصرفاته.

3.o: تتعرف (إيلين) على مجموعة أصدقاء جدد يمثلون النسخ المعاكسة والمثالية تماماً لـ (جيري) و(جورج) و(كرايمر)، بينما يستغل (كرايمر) مبنى إدارياً للعمل فيه كعامل وهمي دون علم أحد.

4.o: تقيم (إيلين) حفلة راقصة لموظفي شركتها، لكن أسلوب رقصها الغريب والسيئ يتسبب في فقدان هيبتها واحترام مرؤوسيها في العمل، ويستعين (جورج) بـ (كرايمر) لمساعدته في موقف ما.

5.o: يشك (جيري) في طبيعة طرد بريدي غامض وصل إلى شقته، وتواجه (إيلين) صعوبة بالغة في الحصول على ملفها الطبي من العيادات بعد أن صُنفت كـ "مريضة صعبة المراس".

6.o: يكتشف (جيري) أن مرشد حبيبته الجديدة في الدراسة هو الكوميديان (كني بانيا) الذي يكرهه، بينما يحاول (جورج) دراسة ملفات معقدة في العمل ويواجه تشتتاً ذهنياً.

7.o: يتلقى (جيري) مئات الشيكات ذات المبالغ الزهيدة جداً من اليابان كأرباح لعرض تلفزيوني قديم شارك فيه، بينما يستضيف (كرايمر) مجموعة من السياح اليابانيين في شقته ويتولى إرشادهم.

8.o: يفتتح مطعم دجاج سريع مقابل مبنى الشقة، ويتسبب ضوؤه الأحمر الساطع في إزعاج (كرايمر)، مما يدفعه لتبادل الشقق مع (جيري)، لتنقلب طباعهما وتصرفاتهما بشكل مضحك.

9.o: يضطر (جورج) للابتعاد عن العلاقات لفترة مؤقتة، ليكتشف أن عقله أصبح يعمل بكفاءة خارقة وذكاء حاد، بينما تكتشف (إيلين) حقيقة غريبة عن الطبيب الذي تواعده حالياً.

10.o: يدخل (جورج) في منافسة شرسة للحصول على شقة أحلامه ضد رجل نجا من حادثة غرق السفينة الشهيرة "أندريا دوريا" ويستعرض قصص بؤسه لاستعطاف المالك، ويحاول جورج التفوق عليه بمآسيه الخاصة.

11.o: يشتري (كرايمر) ديكاً ويطلق عليه اسم "جيري الصغير"، لكنه يقع في مأزق عندما يكتشف أن صاحب المتجر يخطط لإدخال الديك في مسابقات غير قانونية، ويحاول الأصدقاء التدخل.

12.o: يمر والدا (جيري) بظروف معينة ويدفعان له مالاً يرفض أخذه حرصاً عليهما، بينما يظن (جورج) أن والديه يمتلكان ثروة ضخمة مخبأة ويحاول بشتى الطرق الوصول إليها ومعرفة حجمها.

13.o: يتعرض (جورج) لإهانة لفظية ساخرة من زميله في العمل أثناء تناول الطعام، ويصبح مهووساً بابتكار الرد المثالي والمفحم عليه، ويسعى لخلق نفس الموقف مجدداً لإحراجه أمام الجميع.

14.o: يواجه (جورج) أزمة مع عصابة محلية تطلق على نفسها "فتيان فان بورين" بسبب إشارة يد عفوية، بينما يقع (جيري) في حيرة من أمره بعد أن يخبره (كرايمر) بتعليق غريب حول الفتاة التي يواعدها.

15.o: يقع خطأ إداري في العمل يجعل رئيس (إيلين) يظن أن هناك موظفة تدعى "سوزي"، وتضطر إيلين لانتحال هذه الشخصية الوهمية لتجد نفسها في دوامة من المهام وحياة مزدوجة مليئة بالمشاكل.

16.o: تسقط من (جيري) أداة تخص حبيبته داخل المرحاض عن طريق الخطأ ويصيبه هوس بالنظافة تجاهها، بينما يتبنى (كرايمر) جزءاً من الطريق السريع للعناية به، ويحاول (جورج) إصلاح حفرة في الشارع.

17.o: يجمع كل من حول (إيلين) على حب الفيلم السينمائي الشهير "المريض الإنجليزي"، وتتعرض لضغط اجتماعي هائل بسبب كراهيتها الشديدة للفيلم وعدم قدرتها على مجاملة معارفها أو رئيسها.

18.o: يعاني (جورج) من الإرهاق المستمر في العمل ويقرر ابتكار مخبأ سري ومريح تحت مكتبه لأخذ قيلولة، لكن خطته تتعقد عندما يقرر رئيسه الصارم انتظاره داخل المكتب لساعات طويلة.

19.o: يبدأ (جورج) في مواعدة امرأة تستخدم عبارة "يادا يادا" بشكل مستمر لتجاوز تفاصيل هامة في قصصها، مما يثير شكوكه وقلقه حول ما تخفيه هذه العبارة من أسرار وأحداث.

20.o: يكتشف (كرايمر) و(نيومان) أنهما قاما بالتخطيط لحفلتين منفصلتين ومتنافستين للاحتفال بقدوم عام 2000، ويبدآن في صراع كوميدي لجذب الأصدقاء والضيوف لحفلاتهما الخاصة.

21.o: تفتتح (إيلين) مشروعاً تجارياً مبتكراً مع رئيسها السابق لبيع الجزء العلوي فقط من حلوى المافن، لكنهما يقعان في مأزق حقيقي حول كيفية التخلص من الأجزاء السفلية المتبقية التي يرفضها الجميع.

22.o: يحصل (جورج) على مكافأة مالية مجزية بعد تركه للعمل، ويقرر استغلال فترة الصيف بالكامل في الاسترخاء التام وعدم القيام بأي مجهود بدني، لكن خطته الكسولة تواجه عقبات غير متوقعة.

1.o: In 1838, at the age of 18, young princess Alexandrina's life is transformed when she ascends the throne of Great Britain and becomes Queen Victoria. Suddenly finding herself freed of the repressive shackles placed on her by her mother's advisor, Conroy, she builds a new alliance with the charismatic prime minister Lord Melbourne.

2.o: Lord Melbourne's resignation as Prime Minister leaves Victoria devastated. As Lord Melbourne's popularity in the house wanes, the Tories eagerly await their imminent triumph, while the Duke of Cumberland views it as a chance to prey on his niece's vulnerability.

3.o: A Chartist uprising in Newport underlines the instability of the monarchy. King Leopold suggests to Victoria that she consider Prince Albert as a possible consort, a development that results in the young queen being surrounded by suitors.

4.o: Prince Albert arrives in England for the first time, and he and Victoria take an instant dislike to each other in an awkward first encounter. Below stairs, Albert's valet clashes with the royal servants, while Skerrett is visited by a girl in need of money.

5.o: Melbourne warns Victoria that Parliament will not be happy about her marrying a German prince, a prediction that proves all too accurate when the Privy Council refuse to grant Albert a royal title. The prince fears for his future in England, while Victoria succumbs to paranoia, becoming convinced that he only intends to marry her for the financial independence he will gain.

6.o: Albert feels he needs a greater role in public affairs, and becomes involved in the anti-slavery movement. Victoria matches wills with the Duke of Sussex to see that her husband is granted more respect, while Skerrett faces a dilemma when she realises that the only person who can save her cousin and child from certain death is the man she trusts the least.

7.o: The queen becomes pregnant, and declares that Albert will become head of state in the event of her death. The developments outrage members of the Tory party, who fear a German prince holding sway over the nation and make arrangements to disrupt his visit to the industrial north. The consort finds an unlikely ally in Sir Robert Peel, who seeks royal approval for the rapidly developing railway. At first, Victoria does not approve, but soon changes her mind when she experiences Peel's creation for herself.

8.o: A heavily pregnant Victoria is frustrated by both Albert and her mother's attempts to confine her to the Palace. Cumberland arrives in London, hoping that Victoria may die in childbirth, as he is still the heir Presumptive. Determined to show herself in public, Victoria goes for a drive and is accosted by an unhinged admirer, desperate to free her from her ‘German tyrant'. Whilst Victoria is taken aback, she is resolute that it will not frighten her and despite Albert's misgiving, goes out again.

1.t: Uneasy Lies the Head that Wears the Crown
1.o: Revolution sweeps across Europe and pressure builds on Victoria with new arrivals at the Palace.

2.o: Victoria must decide whether to fight the Chartists with force or allow them to present their petition.

3.o: At Osborne House, Albert relishes the opportunity to spend time with the family away from London, but Victoria is desperate to get back to the Palace and the business of politics.

4.o: When Albert leaves the Palace for Cambridge, Victoria faces the traumatic impact of a cholera epidemic on the streets of London.

5.o: After an assassination attempt, the Royal household visit Ireland. Intrigue, conflict and romance all blossom during a stay at the Palmerston estate.

6.o: A Georgian ball at the Palace could not come at a worse time as private pictures of the Royal family are made public.

7.o: Albert and Palmerston put their reputations on the line, and Victoria must fight against her better judgment to decide where to place her allegiance.

8.o: The world's eyes are on the Great Exhibition, and the Royal couple. Does triumph or failure beckon? Lives will be changed forever as intrigue unfolds amongst the exhibits.

1.o: Cevdet is betrayed by his blood brother, Tevfik. Cevdet is a major in Thessaloniki towards the end of the Balkan War. A brave soldier for the motherland, a love lover for his wife Azize; his children Ali Kemal, a compassionate father to Yildiz and Hilal. When Cevdet and Tevfik battle on the front, everything upset with an event. Cevdet is forced to break from his family. Tevfik helps Azize, who had to migrate from Thessaloniki to Izmir.

2.o: Cevdet's return as a Greek colonel shakes all family and Tevfik up. The family is disappointed with his treachery except his elder daughter Yildiz. It won't be easy to regain his family for Cevdet.

3.o: Tevfik is unaware of leaving hint in the mosque. Azize wants to divorce Cevdet. Cevdet accepts with one condition. She gets disappointed because he gives up easily. Cevdet's treachery endangers his family.

4.o: After the fire Cevdet makes an important decision and brings his family to Greek Mansion. On the other hand, Cevdet chases Eftalya. Tevfik endangers Cevdet's life.

5.o: Cevdet faces death with Tevfik's trap. Azize worries about Ali Kemal and she decides to espouse Yildiz for avoiding from Leon. Hilal makes a dangerous plan. Leon is fighting for his life alone after the attack.

6.o: Cevdet's decision puts Cevdet and Tevfik on the spot. Azize comes face to face with death. Hilal and Leon come across, it becomes important milestone of their lives.

7.o: Cevdet has to get rid of Hasan the Immortal. Tevfik is undecided about Azize. Turkish public become hopeful with Amasya Circular but The Allies sends help to Greeks. Cevdet's duty is destroying the arsenal.

8.o: Hasan the Immortal is seized. Leon's doubts about Cevdet confuse Vasili's mind. Cevdet tries to learn the guns' place from him but Hasan threatens Cevdet with uncover him. Hasan the Immortal intends to give a secret to Azize.

9.o: Hilal and Mehmet arrests for exploding Greek arsenal. Everyone is shocked Vasili's execution decision for Hilal. Cevdet is grieved because his daughter gets punishment for his crime.

10.o: Cevdet and all family try to save Hilal. Halide Edip comes to Izmir and becomes hope for Azize. Cevdet has a last ditch for saving his daughter.

11.o: Cevdet's plan works, Esref takes hostage Leon when he tries to save Hilal. Vasili endangers Leon's life and orders to Cevdet to kill Esref. Eftalya learns everything about Tevfik and goes to Azize to tell.

12.o: Cevdet learns Tevfik is the traitor he was looking for. Their rivalry becomes different. Azize is decisive about Yildiz's marriage but Yildiz hopes Leon's help.

1.o: The foremost authority in women's psychology, psychologist SOO. Is he ousted from his domain by the intuitive Helga, who sees through everything at a glance? A confrontation unfolds around Madame Antoinette's name! And the first client, gymnast Mari, has arrived!

2.o: As Helga and Soo begin their counseling sessions, a psychological experiment on love unfolds simultaneously. Between counseling and psychology, a game of push and pull ensues between Soo and Helga. Meanwhile, during gymnast Mari's session, Soo inadvertently hurts her, leading the session over to Helga...

3.o: While secretly preparing an event at a hotel for Helga, Soo is caught off by her sudden appearance. Flustered, he confesses his feelings to her. Meanwhile, top star Ju-ni suffers a seizure during rehearsal and seeks help at the center. Using Ju-ni's counseling as an excuse, Helga and Soo starts their first date.

4.o: To win Helga's favor, Soo buys her a luxury bag, but Helga playfully teases him in return. Meanwhile, Seungchan and Jiho join forces in their mission to charm Helga, while Ju-ni's gets furious by jealousy towards Helga.

5.o: After a date, Soo forgets his role as Experiment Man A with Helga, caught between his duties and growing romantic feelings. Meanwhile, Helga finds herself in a tense situation with Yurim's colleague, Seongho, leading to get detained by the police.

6.o: Soo lies to deceive Helga about the experiment, yet he wrestles with guilt over her. Worried that his personal feelings might disrupt the experiment, Soo quits the Experiment Man A and recruits a new replacement. Meanwhile, Helga finds herself increasingly intrigued by the new Experiment Man A.

7.o: Helga ends things with Soo after he lies about his relationship with the professor. Determined to win Helga back, Soo devises a new strategy. They both encounter Yuseon, a famous magician suffering from dissociative identity disorder during a magic show, and bond while counseling Yuseon together. Meanwhile, Seungchan expresses his love for Helga by painting on a wall.

8.o: Soo and Helga confirm their love with a passionate kiss and continue their secret relationship. However, Helga's lingering suspicions about the experiment lead her to ask Soo to delete experiment-related documents, which deeply troubles him once more. Meanwhile, Helga organizes an event to comfort Soo, who is grappling with childhood trauma, but Soo finds Helga's efforts somewhat awkward.

9.o: With Soo's heartfelt confession, he and Helga become perfect lovers. However, witnessing Helga being used in Soo's experiment, Seungchan cannot stand idly by. He attempts to reveal the truth to Helga, along with Jiho. Meanwhile, while Soo and Helga are on a one-day trip, Helga discovers the code to Soo's hidden safe and tries to open it.

10.o: Finally discovering the truth of the experiment, Helga assigns Seungchan and Jiho to monitor Soo's every move, plotting her revenge. Soo, sensing Helga's coldness, tries everything to thaw her heart, but Helga plans a counter-experiment to dismantle Soo once and for all.

11.o: As Helga begins a counter-experiment, she constantly picks fights and accuses him of losing interest. She demands that Soo undergo an fMRI scan to prove his feelings. As her second strategy, she introduces a young and attractive experiment woman to Soo. However, as Soo and the experiment woman grow closer, Helga finds herself extremely jealous.

12.o: Disappointed with Soo for continuing the experiment, Helga breaks up with him, leaving Soo hurt and confused by her sudden change. Despite her anger, Helga can't let go of her love for Soo. Meanwhile, Soo discovers that Tae-hwa impersonates him. While following Tae-hwa, Soo finally uncovers his secret.

13.o: Helga's jealousy erupts with the sudden appearance of Soo's ex-lover. At a party, Miran's confession of her feelings for Seungchan is revealed, causing her to flee in embarrassment. Meanwhile, Soo sends Helga a flower basket as a task. It is only upon receiving Helga's heartfelt video message that Soo finally understands the depth of her love.

14.o: Upon hearing about Miran's thyroid cancer, Seungchan goes to Jeju Island to find her. Meanwhile, Soo, realizing his love for Helga, decides to finally end the experiment and contemplates how to convey his true feelings to her. At the same time, Helga plans an unforgettable "special" date for Soo.

15.o: After Helga leaves Seoul, Soo struggles with the pain of her absence. He musters the courage to meet Yeonhee, but she barely remembers that she had abandoned him. Soo finds himself utterly broken and alone.

16.o: Helga is shocked by Yurim's pregnancy news, and Miran decides to undergo surgery after Seungchan's persuasion. To comfort Soo, Helga takes him to a place from his childhood, where he confronts his younger self. Meanwhile, Helga's anxiety grows due to Soo's unpredictable behavior, and she receives a mysterious letter.

1.o: Dave runs for office and offers a look at life in slow motion. Dave also plays Samuel L Jackson in a beer commercial, and co-commentates on the first-ever "Racial Draft."

2.o: Dave looks at what it would be like to have a black version of watermelon-smashing comedian Gallagher. Paul Mooney plays "Negrodamus" and Dave plays Calvin, who gets a job at WacArnolds. Also featuring music performer DMX.

3.o: Dave Chappelle examines the age-old myth about white people's inability to dance. Dave tries out a new sleep aid. The Three Daves: A retrospective look at Dave at age 18, 24 and 30.

4.o: Dave unveils the Love Contract and offers up the True Hollywood Story of actor Charlie Murphy, along with musical guest Ludacris.

5.o: Paul Mooney provides answers about the mysteries of life as "Negrodamus." "Charlie Murphy's True Hollywood Story" focuses on Prince, as he takes to the basketball court. Also featuring musical guest Cee-Lo.

1.o: With her father gone, Jae-rim is left all alone, and the only things he left for her were debt and a piece of paper about an announcement on the recruitment at Chungdam Heaven. Accepting the miserable truth, she decides to give it a shot and get a job as a manager at Chungdam Heaven, so she can find her Prince Charming to start a new life.

2.o: Jae-rim ruins her interview and returns home, but Cha-min can't stop thinking about her. Therefore, he decides to hire her as an Angel Manager at Chungdam Heaven. However, he quickly gets disappointed when he realizes she is desperate for marriage, not for the job.

3.o: Jae-rim secures a position at Chungdam Heaven, aiming to elevate her modest lifestyle by finding a wealthy partner. However, her optimism fades as her eccentric boss assigns her menial tasks. Faced with a bleak reality and an uncertain future, her aspirations of marrying into wealth through Chungdam Heaven appear increasingly futile. Meanwhile, Cha-min begins to develop unusual sentiments toward Jae-rim.

4.o: Jae-rim meets the man of her dreams at Chungdam Heaven and believes he’s her ticket out of her lowly life. Seeing her desperate to do anything to reach her goal makes Cha-min think she’s pathetic, yet he feels a twinge of jealousy as she gets closer to another man. He won’t admit it but he can’t stop thinking about her. At a party, Jae-rim expects great things with her dream guy, but things don't go as planned.

5.o: Dan-ah storms out of the hall as Cha-min helps Jae-rim out of the trouble. However, Jae-rim still feels humiliated as she realises all the club members are looking down on her, except for Do-hong, who understands how she feels as he once has been in her situation.

6.o: Cha-min decides to become Jae-rim's Fairy Godmother and help her with Do-hong, while Jae-rim gets disappointed as he seems like he is not into her at all. Meanwhile, Do-hong confesses his feelings to Jae-rim and offers her to work on his film with him.

7.t: If You Don't Say It, They'll Never Know
7.o: Cha-min saves Jae-rim from Dan-ah's uncles, and Jae-rim realizes he truly cares about her. However, she believes that he is not confessing his feelings to her because she is way below his league. Furthermore, she has a huge fight with Hwa-jin and leaves the house. Meanwhile, Do-hong comes back to Chungdam Heaven to see Jae-rim.

8.o: Cha-min visits his father, and he warns him to be aware of women who approach him for his wealth. He feels awful as he reminds him of his mother who left him when he was little. Meanwhile, Do-hong brings a guest to Chungdam Heaven.

9.o: Jae-rim helps Cha-min have a heart-to-heart chat with his mother for the first time. As Dan-ah realises Cha-min's feelings for Jae-rim get deeper, she uses it as a threat and forces him to rush the wedding. Meanwhile, Do-hong asks Jae-rim to quit working at Chungdam Heaven and go to Berlin with him.

10.o: After Jae-rim hears the news about Chungdam Heaven going bankrupt, she starts to worry about Cha-min. Therefore, she sneaks into Chungdam Heaven to check up on him. Meanwhile, Cha-min brings a guest to his father before he leaves him to become Prince Charming without his help.

1.o: The doors of the past open one by one

Former book editor Susan Ryeland is in Crete, running a struggling hotel with her partner Andreas when a couple arrive and ask Susan for help finding their missing daughter. They believe her disappearance is connected to a murder which happened at their own hotel in England as well as the Alan Conway novel that was inspired by the case.

2.o: Susan checks into the Treherne's hotel and meets Lisa, Cecily's sister and Aiden, Cecily's husband. As she investigates she learns more from the hotel night manage and spa manager, both of whom indicate that former employee Stefan was correctly found guilty in the murder of Frank Parris.

3.o: Susan decides to go to London to investigate what Alan Conway knew about the Frank Parris murder. DS Locke catches up with Susan and warns her to stay away from the case.

4.o: Susan meets with Alan's ex-partner, who tells her that Alan knew Frank quite well. He also tells Susan that Frank had a relationship with a sex worker named Leo which could be a clue.

5.o: The Endicotts reveal that Martin Webster had a motive to kill Cecily. Liam Corby tells Susan that that he knows a secret of Lisa's. Susan's sister reminds her that Andreas loves her, and what a good pair they make.

6.o: Susan and Andreas visit Stefan in prison. With help from Pünd, Susan puts the pieces together to solve the cases of both Frank Parris and Cecily.

1.o: Yu Jae-seok recruits Lee Kwang-soo, Byeon Woo-seok and Ji Ye-eun to build a one-of-a-kind camp — but panic brews before the arrival of the guests.

2.o: Full of excitement and surprises, Jae-seok kicks off introductions with a set of ground rules. But soon, the group scrambles to put food on the table.

3.o: On their first day, the group dives into a fun, lively game they've always dreamed of playing — in a place full of surprises and laughter.

4.o: Day 2 kicks off with a surprise mission. From cooking to cleaning, the staff powers through a non-stop day of chores — but it's too early to feel tired!

5.o: The staff comes up with a thoughtful parting gift for the guests. After a delicious dinner, a sentimental campfire gives way to a lively talent show.

6.o: A new batch of guests arrives. Just when Jae-seok and his staff think they've mastered hosting, surprising allies appear right when they need help.

7.o: Two surprise celebrity visitors shake up the camp, using their expertise to whip Jae-seok's B&B into shape — bringing order and deepening connections.

8.o: The day kicks off with a classic variety show-style wake-up mission. What makes Lee Sang-soon reach for his guitar? Later, Lee Hyo-ri leads a yoga class.

9.o: The guests reveal their true identities — shocking the guessers. Later, they go fruit picking before taking the stage for jaw-dropping performances.

10.o: It's time for guests to find out their secret Santa. With gifts and heartfelt letters bringing tears, the group treasure memories before returning home.
